subject.title: fix(duckduckgo): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Which open PR should own the identical shared web-search abort-terminal change while preserving both providers' distinct signal-propagation fixes?
rationale: The generic production change is duplicated across two viable branches, and selecting its landing owner requires maintainer coordination rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use SearXNG as shared lead
options.body: Land the proof-positive shared runtime change from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216, then rebase this PR to its DuckDuckGo-specific changes and proof.

options.title: Use DuckDuckGo as shared lead
options.body: Require DuckDuckGo live proof first, then coordinate the SearXNG branch to remove its duplicate shared runtime change.

recommendation.title: Use SearXNG as shared lead
recommendation.body: Land the proof-positive shared runtime change from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216, then rebase this PR to its DuckDuckGo-specific changes and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent refactor owns the current shared fallback loop and DuckDuckGo implementation, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
